description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for generating leave reports in the OrangeHRM system. It maps report types to report classes and includes a method to retrieve the appropriate report based on request parameters, with validation for report name.

classes.name: LeaveReportAPI
classes.description: API class for generating various leave reports, extending the base ReportAPI class, with a mapping of report identifiers to report classes and a method to retrieve the correct report based on request parameters.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the report class instance based on the report name parameter, throws a BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
